text:
Incident-Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Critical - multiple runtime pods (redwood-runtime) in cluster-us-west-2 are CrashLoopBackOff with SIGSEGV. Approx 18% serving capacity degraded, several customer routes returning 5xx. Incident ticket INC-2026-9874 created. Please @oncall respond.

Sam: I'm taking the page. hitting the cluster now. pulling logs from failing pod first.

Sam: logs show repeated SIGSEGV inside fused_attention kernel on TRT path. snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T09:10:12Z runtime[pid=3142] SIGNAL 11 (Segmentation fault)
#0 0x7f8a3b12 in fused_attention_kernel(void*) at fused_kernels.cu:412
#1 0x7f8a2a8d in run_inference(model_state*)
#2 0x55b3c4 in handle_request(request_context*)
```
stacktrace is truncated. core dump not yet captured (container restarts too fast).

Priya: copying commands to fetch pod + describe: 
`kubectl get pods -n redwood-runtime -l app=runtime -o wide`
`kubectl logs rwd-runtime-abcde -n redwood-runtime --previous`
`kubectl describe pod rwd-runtime-abcde -n redwood-runtime`

Luca: we've seen similar SIGSEGV when fused-kernel compiled with TF32->FP16 conversion enabled on certain driver combos. Which image tag are these pods running?

Sam: image=redwood/runtime:canary-2026-03-10 (gpu-optimized build).

Jing: hmm canary has the new fused-attention optimized kernel from the TRT pipeline. quick mitigation: disable fused path and roll pods to fallback build. Two actionable options: 
- set env `RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1` on the deployment and restart, OR
- roll image back to `redwood/runtime:v3.4.2-fallback` which uses safe kernels.

Sam: applying env var now to one replica to test: `kubectl set env deploy/runtime RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1 -n redwood-runtime --env=RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1` (canary rollout to one AZ).

SREBot: :white_check_mark: patch applied to deploy/runtime. rolling update started (3/6 pods updated).

Priya: while that rolls, we should collect a core from a failing container to confirm root cause. steps: 
1) `kubectl exec -it rwd-runtime-abcde -n redwood-runtime -- /bin/sh` (quickly)
2) `gcore -o /tmp/core.$(hostname) $(pidof runtime)` (if gcore present)
3) `tar czf /tmp/collect-logs.tgz /tmp/core.* /var/log/runtime/*.log`
4) `kubectl cp rwd-runtime-abcde:/tmp/collect-logs.tgz ./`
If container restarts before gcore finishes, use `kubectl debug` to pause crash, or enable `core_pattern` on node and use `coredumpctl`.

Dinesh: FYI I've started draining the node with the most failing pods to reduce customer impact: `kubectl cordon node/usw2-gpu-12 && kubectl drain node/usw2-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

Nora: customers impacted list from routing service: 
- routes: /v1/generate (model: redwood-13b-quant, variants: canary-2026-03-10)
- Affected tenants: tenant-omega, tenant-skyline (approx 12 active keys)
Errors: 502/503 spikes starting 09:09Z, error rate peaked ~14% for the cluster.

Sam: with env var set, new pods are coming up. monitoring logs... new pod shows no SIGSEGV so far. rolling update proceeding.

Jing: when you set `RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED=1`, runtime falls back to non-fused attention kernels (slower, but stable). This avoids the TRT fused path which appears to hit a nullptr in our latest canary kernel for certain sequence lengths.

Priya: please also patch the canary image in our staging to reproduce: we need a reproducer before merging kernel fixes.

Sam: rollback to fallback image in progress for the remaining replicas: `kubectl set image deploy/runtime runtime=redwood/runtime:v3.4.2-fallback -n redwood-runtime`

SREBot: :rotating_light: Incident INC-2026-9874 | severity=P1 | Status: mitigation-in-progress | Assigned: Sam, Priya | Pager: Dinesh

Luca: quick note on drivers: affected nodes show NVIDIA driver 535.54; TRT fused kernels were validated on 535.71 in internal test matrix. possible ABI mismatch. I'm raising compatibility warning to infra.

Priya: collecting metrics to estimate customer impact: 
- 5xx count by tenant at 09:20Z: tenant-omega 134 errors, tenant-skyline 98 errors.
- median latency for /v1/generate during incident: 820ms -> NORMAL 220ms (due to retries/fallbacks).

Sam: mitigation status update at 09:28Z: 6/6 pods healthy after rollback+env. serving capacity restored to 99%. error rate back to baseline 0.5%.

Jing: next steps: 
- capture cores and reproduce in staging with same driver (535.54) and canary kernel.
- revert canary rollout until kernel fix available.
- add automated preflight to fail canary if fused kernel reports alignment checks.

Nora: I'm going to prepare a short customer-facing summary for support to send to tenants: brief note + timeline + what we did.

Dinesh: oncall handoff: I'll be oncall for the next 2 hours to monitor. Sam, if you need escalation, ping me.

Sam: thanks everyone. capturing artifact links: 
- logs bundle: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-9874/logs.tgz
- core dumps: s3://redwood-incident-logs/INC-2026-9874/cores/
- incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/INC-2026-9874

SREBot: :white_check_mark: Incident resolved -> mitigated via rollback and env override. Monitoring for 30m. Create follow-up ticket for root-cause and test-matrix fix (RFC-2026-331).

Priya: postmortem owner? Sam volunteer?

Sam: I can own the postmortem. Will draft and link to incident doc.

Incident-Bot: :information_source: Thread closed to new replies (auto) - reopen if regression observed.

Jing: adding final note: add `RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED` to canary runbook and add driver-check gate in CI.

Nora: thanks team.
